title: 第1448章 落在我手里算你倒霉第1447章 这样好的吃食简直是在
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 无人机在巡逻，河岸边小三轮车大喇叭循环喊话。
原本百姓们看见水位上升到自己的脚下，应该激动地痛哭，磕头感谢神明赐水。
被小三轮和无人机通报，都给愣住了。
小三轮车见大家还愣着，中气十足大喊：“发香皂了，别愣着，每人一块不能多领！”
“赶紧洗澡，你们不想洗，城门口三万人还在排队呢！”
大家一听，来不及叩谢神明赐水之恩，拿了香皂一窝蜂地跑到河岸边。
水位上升，大家也就在岸上没过脚踝地方洗。
战家军还钉上木桩，拉了钢丝线，所有洗澡的百姓不能超过钢线，以免失足落水。
挑选的巡逻人员都会浮水。
并在木状上放置救生圈，一旦有人失足落水，把救生圈抛下去，能救人一命！
刚才男女老少挤在一处，现在全部都分流，小孩和女人们去隔壁西面洗……四百万人尽量三天之内全部清洗完毕。
以前的旧衣裳拿去洗，若是不洗会被战家军烧掉！
实在是没有衣裳的，把旧衣服拿去给战家，他们会发放新布。
说是消毒！
城中百姓大部分穿得破破烂烂，衣裳质量，大多都是针脚稀疏的麻布衣。
而战家军发下来的布匹，是纯棉布，上面还印着漂亮的花。
若是没有闹干旱前，这样的布匹，清晰的印花，鲜艳的颜色，一年的工钱都买不来一批布料。
战家军却让他们拿破麻布，缝满补丁的旧衣去换。
布料明显不是这个时代的产物，是神明赠与吧？拿到布料的老百姓，一边抹泪，一边嘴里念叨：“感谢神明让我们都有新衣裳穿！”
“以后咱们再也不用光膀子！”
“一匹布做全家衣裳足够了！”
“多谢神明赐的布料！”
叶苜苜特意查看布料库存，也不知道范靖收了多少家布料厂的积压库存。
放置布料的仓库，占地足足十几亩。
布料多到数不胜数。
范靖还特意划出一片区域，专门用来种植棉花，在空间里建了布厂，服装厂。
已经开始投产。
为一年之后古代冰封零下几十度做准备。
自从发放布匹开始，几乎全城的百姓都想拿到布料。
有的百姓衣服并没有破，也要拿出精美瓷器兑换。
李潇请示过叶苜苜是否兑换。
叶苜苜回答准予兑换……百姓们排队在各个主城街道兑换布匹。
仅仅一天不到的时间里，齐国都城百姓面貌发生了翻天覆地的大变化。
不再一个个垂头丧气，双眼无神地躺在路边等死。
现在路上随便一个饥民，嘴角都咧着笑，眼睛迸发出巨大神采。
仿佛以后的日子天天赛神仙似的。
尤其是在战家军伙夫房找到工作的，哪怕工作是烧柴火的，每个月都能领取不低于十五斤的粮食。
战家军包吃包住，以后再也不会饿死，还有一个稳定养家糊口的工作。
他们对未来充满希望。
护城河神明已经赐下神水，用不了多久，齐国城郊外面的几条河流都会灌满水。
到那时，城外荒废的田地就能耕种，粮食种出来后，饥荒问题迎刃而解。
一想到这，大家伙就更高兴了！
他们目前能做的，和战家军交易，兑换物资。
下河洗澡，洗干净消毒。
content_en:
,,!
Drones are patrolling, and tricycles on the river bank are shouting loudly through loudspeakers.
Originally, when the people saw the water level rising to their feet, they should have cried with excitement, kowtowed and thanked the gods for the water.
They were all stunned when they were informed by the tricycle and the drone.
When the tricycle saw that everyone was still stunned, he shouted angrily: "Soap is being distributed, don't be stunned, each person can't get more than one piece!"
"Hurry up and take a shower. If you don't want to take a shower, 30,000 people are still queuing up at the city gate!"
When everyone heard this, they had no time to thank God for the gift of water, so they took soap and swarmed to the river bank.
As the water level rose, everyone washed on the shore up to their ankles.
Zhan Jiajun also nailed wooden stakes and pulled steel wires. All the people bathing could not exceed the steel wires to avoid slipping and falling into the water.
Selected patrol officers will float.
And place a lifebuoy on the wooden structure. Once someone slips and falls into the water, throwing the lifebuoy down can save someone's life!
Just now, men, women, old and young were crowded together in one place, but now they are all separated. The children and women go to the west next door to wash... Four million people try to wash all of them within three days.
Take the old clothes to be washed. If you don't wash them, they will be burned by the Zhan family army!
If you really don’t have any clothes, take your old clothes to the Zhan family and they will give you new cloth.
It's said to be disinfection!
Most of the people in the city were dressed in rags, and the quality of their clothes was mostly linen clothes with sparse stitching.
The cloth handed out by Zhan Jiajun was pure cotton with beautiful flowers printed on it.
Before the drought, a year's wages would not be able to buy a batch of fabrics like this, with clear prints and bright colors.
Zhan Jiajun asked them to change into old clothes full of torn linen and patches.
The fabric is obviously not a product of this era. It is a gift from the gods, right? The people who got the cloth wiped away their tears and chanted: "Thank God for giving us new clothes to wear!"
"We don't have to be shirtless anymore!"
"One piece of cloth is enough to make clothes for the whole family!"
"Thank you God for the cloth!"
Ye Milu specially checked the fabric inventory and didn't know how many fabric factories Fan Jing had collected.
The warehouse where the fabrics are placed covers an area of ​​more than ten acres.
There is so much fabric that you can’t even count it.
Fan Jing also specially designated an area specifically for growing cotton, and built a cloth factory and a clothing factory in the space.
Production has started.
Prepare for the ancient ice to freeze to dozens of degrees below zero a year later.
Since the cloth was distributed, almost everyone in the city wanted to get it.
Some people's clothes were not torn, but they still had to exchange exquisite porcelain.
Li Xiao asked Ye Clover whether to redeem it.
Ye Clover replied that the exchange was allowed... the people lined up in the streets of various main cities to exchange cloth.
In less than a day, the appearance of the people in the capital of Qi has undergone earth-shaking changes.
No longer are all of them lying on the roadside with their heads downcast and their eyes blank, waiting for death.
Now any hungry man on the road has a grin on his face and a huge sparkle in his eyes.
It was as if I was competing against gods every day in the days to come.
Especially those who find a job in the Zhan family's military cookhouse, even if the job is to burn firewood, they can receive no less than fifteen kilograms of food every month.
Zhan Jiajun will receive food and accommodation, and will never starve to death again, and he will have a stable job to support his family.
They are full of hope for the future.
The gods of the moat have given divine water, and it won't be long before the rivers outside Qi's suburbs will be filled with water.
By then, the abandoned fields outside the city can be cultivated, and after food is grown, the problem of famine will be solved.
When I think of this, everyone is even happier!
What they can do now is trade with the Zhan Family Army to exchange supplies.
Go to the river to take a bath, clean and disinfect.
title_en: Chapter 1448: It’s bad luck for you if you fall into my hands. Chapter 1447: Such good food is simply amazing.
